title: Thinq Metric0 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thinq:metric0 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for thinq metric0 data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for thinq metric0 events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It treats the smoothed week-long trend in your value from thinq metric0.
